title: Esthetic bugs on version 3.0.0.1 graph
symptom: On version 3.0.0.1 (master) two bugs regarding the displayed graph: 1. Last reading displayed on top but not on graph. 2. More rarely, only a part of the graph is displayed (the most updated part). Both problems are resolved by switching the graph all the way to 24hr and back to 3hr view.
fix: The second point has been solved in dev. The first point is also reported as resolved in dev by a maintainer comment: 'hopefully resolved in dev'.
evidence_quote: The second point has been solved in dev.
